title: Just wanted to say thanks! Giving away all the assets I use to build my games for free (next 24 hours only)
author: OutOfTokensStudios
selftext:
Hey everyone!

Just wanted to say a huge thank you to all of you. I've learned a ton from lurking, reading devlogs, and picking up tips from game dev communities like this one, and I wanted to give something back ahead of Thanksgiving. So for the next 24 hours only (until tomorrow, Nov 25 at 7 PM PST), I made every single asset pack on my itch page 100% free:

https://outoftokensstudio.itch.io

These are the actual assets I make and use to build my own games over on Wavedash (https://wavedash.com/teams/out-of-tokens-studios), if you want to see how some of them look in action.

There's a pretty wide mix on the page right now:  
\* Rigged and animated 3D characters (surfing/snowboarding animals, penguins, a yeti, Chinese zodiac animals, etc.)  
\* Low-poly 3D kits (a huge Wild West town, ski resort, tropical beach, pirate ship, night city)  
\* Volumetric sky and water shaders for Godot 4 and Unity 6, plus a bunch of 2D combat VFX  
\* Full UI kits for Godot, Unity, and HTML5 (JRPG, Cyberpunk, Post-Apoc, Motorsport, Origami)  
\* Tons of 2D packs like fantasy portraits, RPG/cyberpunk skill icons, card battler sets, chess sets, backgrounds, and music

Once you claim them on itch they stay in your library, so feel free to grab whatever looks fun or stash stuff for your next game jam. 

Happy to answer any questions about how the packs are set up or how I used them in my games. Thanks again everyone, and hope you have a great week!

\- might have some old fleshy sounds let me check, Alien music also? I have a lot of copyright free generated music that’s not in there. Might be fun to try to make some also  
\- Have some humans rigged up, can share those when I’m back at my computer… wait 3d or 2d rigging? I have 3d. I can share the characters from the above game if you think they’ll be helpful

comments.author: Knoblauch12
comments.body:
Dude this is fucking awesome! Thank you! I’m just working on my first project and can’t wait to use these. 

Seeing you offer some more backlog in other comments - if you have any low poly modular building assets for a fantasy style game or anything for lighting it’d be a huge help! I’m making a 3D survival game in a fantasy setting.

replies.author: OutOfTokensStudios
replies.body:
That sounds awesome would love a fantasy rust style game.

Haven’t worked on a 3d fantasy game yet, so haven’t made much for that genre. Your looking for modular components? Interior or exterior? Exterior seems like it might be difficult for modular parts, curious to see what you are cooking. 

Haven’t made anything specific for lighting. Would be interested to know more what your looking for maybe can help. Godot has done a solid job for lighting for me with little effort so far

replies.author: Knoblauch12
replies.body:
That’s reassuring to hear - I haven’t done anything aesthetic yet. It’s a somewhat unique game - a bit tower defense, a bit survival, and a bit of rpg so it’ll be somewhat unique! 

Asset-wise, 3D monsters, player models, armor models, models for items when they’re outside of your inventory (ie thrown on ground), 3d plants, trees, wooden/stone/iron blocks and windows and all that would be of huge help! 

Otherwise 3D models of torches, couldrons, tables, books, bookshelves, alembics, distillers, kegs, beds, potted plants, candles, candelabras, store UI’s, borders for dialogue boxes - I have nothing so everything is amazing! Hah
